dogecoin.text: #Dogecoin over the years has seen significant growth whenever Elon Musk posts a tweet or something related to #Dogecoin on Twitter. And now that he has the full ownership of Twitter could Dogecoin Twitter campaign get a new boost its been craving for for a while now?

Elon finally is the new #Twitter Owner. 

A new era for #Twitter has begun as Musk's $48b acquisition has been approved.

But what could this mean for Dogecoin...
